class_name: 意志-決定-コトニスル類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: 〜ことにする marks a decision the speaker makes for themselves (contrast 〜ことになる, a decision that comes down from outside), and the inserted は sets that decision against a reservation, so a clause like が・ものの・けれど almost always follows. Pick it over 〜ようにする (1871) when the point is the one-off resolution itself rather than sustained effort. Takes the dictionary or ない form of the verb (行かないことにした); 〜ことにしている shifts the same verb to a standing practice.

examples.ruby: 参加[さんか]することにはしたが、気[き]が進[すす]まない。
examples.english: I did decide to take part, but my heart isn't in it.

examples.ruby: 医者[いしゃ]に行[い]くことにはしましたが、まだ迷[まよ]っています。
examples.english: I've decided to see a doctor, though I'm still of two minds about it.

examples.ruby: 毎日[まいにち]記録[きろく]を付[つ]けることにはしたものの、三日[みっか]で終[お]わった。
examples.english: I made up my mind to keep a daily log, and it lasted all of three days.

glosses: make a point of …, for what it's worth
patterns.usage_note: 〜ようにする is about ongoing effort or arrangement — steering yourself toward a habit — whereas its sibling 〜ことにする (1861) reports a decision already taken; 〜ようにしている describes the habit as established. ようにゃ is a colloquial squeeze of ようには, so it carries the same concessive flavour as ことにはし; the contracted にゃ is heavily colloquial and reads as rough or old-fashioned speech, and the uncontracted ようには is the form learners should produce. The dictionary-form attachment means a negative goes on the verb (食べないようにする), not on する.

examples.ruby: 早[はや]く返事[へんじ]をするようにゃしてるんだが、つい遅[おく]れる。
examples.english: I do make a point of replying quickly, but I always end up late anyway.

examples.ruby: 毎朝[まいあさ]白湯[さゆ]を飲[の]むようにはしているが、効果[こうか]は分[わ]からない。
examples.english: I do make a point of drinking hot water every morning, though I can't tell it's doing anything.

examples.ruby: 甘[あま]い物[もの]を控[ひか]えるようにはしたが、体重[たいじゅう]は減[へ]らない。
examples.english: I did try to cut back on sweets, but my weight hasn't budged.
